title: Hook
description: A webhook subscription object that defines what registry events trigger notifications and where those notifications are sent.

id.description: The unique identifier for this hook subscription.

username.description: The npm username of the hook owner.

name.description: The name of the entity being watched. For packages, this is the package name. For scopes, this is the scope name. For owners, this is the npm username.

type.description: The type of entity being watched.

endpoint.description: The URI where webhook payloads will be sent via HTTP POST.

last_delivery.description: Information about the last delivery attempt.

id.description: The identifier of the last delivery.

timestamp.description: When the last delivery was attempted.

status.description: The HTTP status code received from the endpoint.

response_code.description: The HTTP response code from the last delivery attempt.

status.description: The current status of the hook subscription.

updated.description: When the hook was last updated.
